messages:
Maria Gomez: quick sync — ran a mid-pass priority speculative decode sweep on ozma-14b (nf4) this morning. results are small but interesting, sharing notes.
Ravi Patel: +1 — what's the config? curious about fallback rules
Maria Gomez: short config snippet:
```
speculative:
  mode: mid-pass
  priority_windows: [8, 16]
  backlog: 2
  entropy_threshold: 2.05
  fallback_after: 3  # commit to full model after 3 tokens mismatch
```
Erin Li: nice. what quant? nf4 static or dynamic?
Maria Gomez: nf4 static with per-channel calibration. we also tried a dynamic per-layer scale for a small subset (see later).
Sam O'Neill: numbers pls — latency / quality tradeoffs
Maria Gomez: p50 single-token latency drop ~22% (from 18ms -> 14ms) when speculative hits; p99 unchanged for steady-state because fallback kicks in. throughput up ~1.6x in our microbench (batch=8, seq=256).
Ravi Patel: quality deltas?
Maria Gomez: overall logprob delta small; on heldout longform summarization Rouge-L -0.6 points with mid-pass; closed-book QA exact-match down 1.8% when using the aggressive entropy_threshold. with more conservative gating (2.3) EM drop <0.7%.
Erin Li: how are you measuring divergence? single-step mismatch or full-output divergence?
Maria Gomez: we use token-level mismatch rate at commit points + end-to-end metric on full outputs. token-mismatch at commit ~1.2% default; divergence that causes BLEU/EM regression correlates with commits that change high-entropy suffixes.
Sam O'Neill: any weird failure modes? hallucinations, repeat loops?
Maria Gomez: noticed a small uptick in trailing hallucination on multi-hop prompts when the prefix included ambiguous referents. hypothesis: speculative picks a different high-prob token early that conditions the rest. mitigation: increase fallback_after to 4 for chains-of-thought style prompts.
Ravi Patel: what about quantization interplay?
Maria Gomez: nf4 static amplified mismatch slightly vs fp16. dynamic per-layer scale reduced token-mismatch by ~0.3% but increased runtime overhead (small). tradeoff worth it for the hardest prompts.
Erin Li: sample size / eval harness?
Maria Gomez: evaluation harness: 3k prompts split across domains (summ, qa, code, convo). run deterministic top-k seeds (k=1/beam) and also sampling seeds for stochastic tests. we record p50/p90/p99 latency, token-mismatch, full-metrics (EM/ROUGE/BLEU), and qualitative flags. run command used:
```
./eval_harness --model ozma-14b-nf4 --spec-policy midpass --holdout /data/ops/holdout_v3.jsonl --out results/midpass_v3.jsonl
```
Sam O'Neill: can you dump a short example where it diverged? for triage
Maria Gomez: pasted an anonymized case:
User: "List steps to troubleshoot a failed database migration"
Full-fp16: "1) check migration logs. 2) verify schema diffs... 3) run dry-run"  <-- correct
Spec-midpass: "1) check migration logs. 2) run dry-run. 3) restore from backup"  <-- changed order and recommends restore prematurely
Ravi Patel: that seems like a context-dependent decision, good example. ops ask: how to roll this safely to canary?
Erin Li: suggested canary config:
- 5% traffic
- deterministic prompts only
- enable stepwise logging + token commit metadata
- auto rollback if EM drop >1% over 24h or token-mismatch >2.5%
Maria Gomez: added that to the canary doc. also annotated prompt categories where mid-pass should be off (coT, legal, medical).
eval-bot: job 87234 finished: 3,000 prompts, midpass hit-rate 42%, token-mismatch 1.18%, EM delta -1.8% (aggressive); conservative run next.
Sam O'Neill: next steps?
Maria Gomez: follow-ups:
- conservative gate sweep (entropy 2.2-2.6)
- try hybrid: fp16 for first N layers + nf4 later
- add commit-weighting: if speculative token prob >0.6, prefer commit
- smoke canary config and run 100k prompt sim
Ravi Patel: thumbs up. can you add the conservative run results when done and a short triage checklist for rollouts?
Maria Gomez: will do, uploading artifacts to /mnt/ops/spec-midpass/ and will ping when conservative run finishes. :thumbsup:
